question: Find users who have received both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges and have edited posts with at least 500 views. For each such user, count how many of their edited posts received votes with a bounty amount of 50 in the year 2011.

prediction.sql: SELECT u.XCL_052 AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_026) AS edited_posts_with_bounty_votes FROM users AS u JOIN postHistory AS ph ON ph.XCL_017 = u.XCL_052 AND ph.XCL_013 = 2 JOIN posts AS p ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014 AND p.XCL_030 >= 500 JOIN votes AS v ON v.XCL_067 = p.XCL_026 AND v.XCL_071 = 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', v.XCL_069) = '2011' WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT b.XCL_002 FROM badges AS b WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher') AND u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT b.XCL_002 FROM badges AS b WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM postHistory AS ph JOIN posts AS p ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014 WHERE ph.XCL_017 = u.XCL_052 AND ph.XCL_013 = 2 AND p.XCL_030 >= 500) GROUP BY u.XCL_052

semantic_memory.interpretation_policy: Assignments are conditional on the proposed role vocabulary; feasibility is not independent validation of business labels. Use original historical SQL and physical observations to compare competing interpretations.

measures.eligibility_application: Measure rows are restricted to edited posts with >=500 views and votes with score 50 in 2011; user eligibility is applied separately by EXISTS.
measures.multiplicity_argument: COUNT(DISTINCT posts.XCL_026) prevents multiple qualifying votes on the same post from inflating the post count.

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    u.XCL_052 AS user_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_026) AS edited_posts_with_bounty_votes
FROM users u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052 AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052 AND b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM postHistory ph
    JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014
    WHERE ph.XCL_017 = u.XCL_052
      AND ph.XCL_013 = 2
      AND p.XCL_030 >= 500
)
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.XCL_017 = u.XCL_052 AND ph.XCL_013 = 2
JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014 AND p.XCL_030 >= 500
JOIN votes v ON v.XCL_067 = p.XCL_026
    AND v.XCL_071 = 50
    AND strftime('%Y', v.XCL_069) = '2011'
GROUP BY u.XCL_052

SELECT
    u.XCL_052 AS user_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_026) AS edited_posts_with_bounty_votes
FROM users u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052 AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052 AND b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM postHistory ph
    JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014
    WHERE ph.XCL_017 = u.XCL_052
      AND ph.XCL_013 = 2
      AND p.XCL_030 >= 500
)
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.XCL_017 = u.XCL_052 AND ph.XCL_013 = 2
JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014 AND p.XCL_030 >= 500
JOIN votes v ON v.XCL_067 = p.XCL_026
    AND v.XCL_071 = 50
    AND strftime('%Y', v.XCL_069) = '2011'
GROUP BY u.XCL_052
